description: This file contains the implementation of the StatelessWorkerGrainContext class, which manages stateless worker grain activations within Orleans. It handles message queuing, worker creation and deactivation, idle worker removal, and lifecycle management for stateless grains.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerGrainContext
classes.description: Manages a collection of stateless worker grain activations, including message processing, worker lifecycle, and idle worker removal strategies.

methods.name: RunMessageLoop
methods.description: Main loop handling queued work items such as messages, activation lifecycle events, and idle worker collection.

methods.name: CollectIdleWorkers
methods.description: Applies a control algorithm to determine if idle workers should be deactivated based on workload metrics.

methods.name: ReceiveMessageInternal
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, assigning them to existing workers or creating new worker activations as needed.

methods.name: CreateWorker
methods.description: Creates and activates a new worker activation for handling messages.

methods.name: DeactivateInternal
methods.description: Deactivates all workers managed by this context.

methods.name: DeactivatedTaskInternal
methods.description: Completes the deactivation process for all workers and signals completion.

methods.name: DisposeAsyncInternal
methods.description: Performs cleanup and disposal of resources, including timers and worker activations.

methods.name: OnCreateActivation
methods.description: Observer callback for creation of a new activation.

methods.name: OnDestroyActivation
methods.description: Observer callback when an activation is destroyed, enqueues cleanup.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Handles rehydration for migration scenarios, currently disposes of rehydration context.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Placeholder for migration logic, currently no-op.
